whenToUse: A four-step campaign wizard: audience, message (email/SMS/push), schedule and review.
Messages that need a live preview, SMS segment counting and pre-send checks.
avoidWhen: A short single-page form — use form-01.
A generic multi-step form without messaging specifics — use multi-step-form.
a11y: Channel choice is a role="radiogroup"; invalid fields use aria-invalid and counters use aria-live.
The test-send email input uses type="email" with autocomplete; keep step headings in order.
